note: The one place for Detent's search copy and URLs (tools/seo/SEO.md). build.mjs reads it on every build. A path is permanent once published: change a title, never a slug (or add a redirect in vercel.json). Titles are the subject first; build.mjs adds ' · ' + name and refuses anything over 60 characters. Descriptions are one or two plain sentences under 160 characters: no counts typed by hand, no invented numbers, no other project's name. Every control in PARTS (src/catalog.html) needs an entry under parts, keyed by its tag; the build stops if one is missing. hubs: one page each at /<slug>, joining the controls whose group is in match.groups; slugs share one namespace with the controls. A hub with fewer than 3 controls is skipped with a note. card names the control its share card shows and its short line.
name: Detent

home.title: Tactile dials, knobs and switches, web and SwiftUI
home.description: Dials, knobs and switches that behave like hardware, with sound and haptics. Web components and SwiftUI files, free and MIT. Made by 37degree.

card.headline: Every notch. Every stop.
card.line: Tactile dials, knobs and switches for the web and iPhone.

detent-encoder.title: Encoder: a detented rotary knob for web and SwiftUI
detent-encoder.description: A rotary encoder knob with 60 detents, a click per notch and hard end stops. A web component with no dependencies, plus a SwiftUI file. Free, MIT.

detent-pot.title: Pot: a potentiometer knob for web and SwiftUI
detent-pot.description: A guitar-pedal potentiometer knob with fine ticks, hard stops, an optional centre detent and double-click reset. Web component and SwiftUI, MIT.

detent-bezel.title: Bezel: a ratcheting rotary dial for web and SwiftUI
detent-bezel.description: An endless ratcheting bezel dial that clicks into each position, with a weighted mode that coasts after a flick. Web component and SwiftUI, MIT.

detent-touch.title: Touch Ring: a dot touch wheel for web and SwiftUI
detent-touch.description: A touch wheel with no moving parts: dots fill as you slide around it, with a tiny tick per step. A web component and a SwiftUI file, free and MIT.

detent-switch.title: Switch: a tactile toggle switch for web and SwiftUI
detent-switch.description: A slide toggle switch that holds against its detent, then snaps over with a two-part click and haptics. Web component and SwiftUI file, MIT.

detent-selector.title: Selector: a rotary switch for web and SwiftUI
detent-selector.description: A rotary selector switch with a few positions, each a spring detent that snaps over with a click, and hard end stops. Web component and SwiftUI, MIT.

detent-slot.title: Slot: a slide selector switch for web and SwiftUI
detent-slot.description: A hi-fi style vertical slide selector: the cap snaps into each named position with a click and stops hard at the ends. Web component and SwiftUI, MIT.

detent-scrubber.title: Time scrubber: a 24-hour slider for web and SwiftUI
detent-scrubber.description: A glass lens slides along a 24-hour scale, clicking every quarter hour and firmer on the hour, and coasts when flicked. Web component and SwiftUI, MIT.

detent-clock.title: Clock: a time picker you set like a real clock
detent-clock.description: A clock time picker: turn the face and the minute hand clicks into each minute, the hour hand follows, and an A/P pusher sets the half. Web and SwiftUI, MIT.

hubs.name: Dials and knobs
hubs.title: Rotary knobs and dials: web components and SwiftUI
hubs.description: Rotary knobs and dials that click through each detent, with sound and haptics. Web components with no dependencies, plus SwiftUI files. Free, MIT.
hubs.intro: Knobs and dials you turn with a finger or a mouse. Each one clicks through its detents with sound and haptics: an encoder with hard end stops, a potentiometer with an optional centre detent, a bezel that ratchets round without end, and a touch ring with no moving parts. Each is one web component with no dependencies, with a SwiftUI file for iPhone and iPad.

card.line: Rotary knobs and dials that click into every detent.

hubs.name: Switches and selectors
hubs.title: Toggle and selector switches for web and SwiftUI
hubs.description: Toggle and selector switches that hold against their detent, then snap over with a click and haptics. Web components and SwiftUI files, free and MIT.
hubs.intro: Switches that resist your finger, then snap to the next position with a click you hear and feel. A slide toggle for on and off, and a rotary selector and a hi-fi slide selector for a few named positions, both with hard end stops. Each is one web component with no dependencies, with a SwiftUI file for iPhone and iPad.

card.line: Toggles and selectors that snap over with a click.
